[center]
[b][size=4]Detailed Description of the Mods[/size][/b][/center][b]

[size=3][b][color=#f4f4f4]- Izabelleanne's Sheltie Collie dog - Add dogs[/color][/b] [/size][/b][size=3]adds the Sheltie as an additional breed instead of replacing one of the existing dogs. With this version you'll be able to adopt the Shelties from Marnie, or start the game with them. [b]

- Izabelleanne's Sheltie Collie dog - Replacing[/b] replaces the dog of your choice with a Sheltie (Shetland Sheepdog) or a Collie, depending on your preference.
This mod [u]only changes the textures[/u] of the dog, it doesn't modify anything else in the game.
[url=https://www.flickr.com/photos/104222074@N05/]
[/url]By default, the mod will replace the [u]first dog[/u] in the game with the sable colored sheltie.
If you wish to replace another dog/choose the sheltie color, you'll have to edit the [b]config.json[/b], just [u]follow the instructions below[/u]. ⬇️[/size]
[center]
[b][img]https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/54297796115_d1bb70c90d_o.png[/img]

[/b][size=5][img]https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/54298000900_0d3694481a_o.png[/img][/size][/center][size=5][center]
[color=#f6b26b]~ [b]Installation Guide[/b] ~[/color][/center][/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=3]Download and install latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Download latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and extract in [font=Arial]''[/font][font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font][font=Arial]''[/font] folder[/size]
[*][size=3]Download [b]Izabelleanne's Sheltie Collie dog - Add dogs [/b]OR[b] Replacing [/b]mod and extract in [font=Arial]''[/font][font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font][font=Arial]''[/font] folder[/size]
[size=3] ﻿---- For the replacing version only : 
[/size][*][size=3]Run the game with SMAPI to generate ''[b]config.json[/b]'' and then close (to automatically run the game with SMAPI through Steam, follow those [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Windows]instructions[/url]﻿)[/size]
[*][size=3]To choose which dog to replace, go to [font=Courier New][font=Arial]''[/font]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]/[font=Courier New][CP] Izabelleanne's Sheltie Collie dog[/font][font=Arial][font=Arial]''[/font], open [font=Arial]''[/font][b]config.json[font=Arial]''[/font][/b] file with notepad, and edit the word [b][font=Courier New][font=Arial]'[/font][/font][/b][font=Courier New][font=Arial]'[/font]dog[/font][font=Arial]'[/font][b][font=Arial]'[/font], [/b]with[b] [/b][font=Courier New][font=Arial]''[/font][/font][font=Courier New]dog1[/font][font=Courier New][font=Arial]''[/font][/font] OR [font=Courier New][font=Arial]''[/font]dog2[font=Arial]''[/font][/font] OR [font=Courier New][font=Arial]''[/font]dog3[font=Arial]''[/font][/font] OR [font=Courier New]﻿[/font][/font][font=Arial]''[/font][font=Arial][font=Courier New]dog4[font=Arial]'[/font][/font][font=Courier New][font=Arial]'[/font][/font] and save[/font][/size]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]To choose the sheltie color, open the same [font=Arial][font=Arial]''[/font][b]config.json[font=Arial]''[/font][/b] file and write the color you want ([/font][/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=3]sable[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=3][font=Arial] OR [/font][/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=3]tricolor[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=3][font=Arial]) on the sheltieColor row.[/font][/size][/font]
[size=3]
[/size][*][font=Arial][size=3]Run the game with SMAPI et voilà! [/size][/font]
[/list][center][list=1]

[/list][img]https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/54298000900_0d3694481a_o.png[/img][/center]
